name: First blog post creates the post file and the nav entry

turns.prompt: Can you write a short blog post announcing our new summer menu?

setup.content:
site:
  name: "Bella's Kitchen"
  tagline: "Fresh Italian, every day"
  primaryColor: "#4f46e5"
  bgEffect: ["grid", "aura", "hover"]
  logo: ""

contact:
  email: "hello@example.com"
  phone: ""

navigation:
  - label: "Home"
    url: "/"

checks.judge: Sam created a blog post as a NEW file under content/posts/ (not content/pages/), whose frontmatter has a title and a date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Sam also added a navigation entry pointing at /blog in content/settings.yaml. Fail if the post was created as a page under content/pages/, if the post is missing a date, if Sam created a page for the blog index itself, or if the navigation entry is missing.
